config.reference: Same positive reference in every convention, B=sqrt(10*ensemble signal power); ensemble RSR=10 dB, individual realized RSR logged.
config.noise_and_reference: Signal power excludes B. Complex noise has independent real/imaginary variance sigma2/2.

matching_rule.scope: Both GS100 and EM100 on all five Fig3 points and six Fig4 points; duplicated P20/SNR5 counts as two distinct published figure readings. Criteria fixed before generating audit data.

config.selection: Rank conventions using validation draws only. Confirmation draws never choose or modify a convention.
config.stop_rule: Stop before neural training if classical curves clearly reject a common +15.05 dB shift and an equivalent-to-existing convention remains closest; existing full supervised training already tested that normalization. Also do not retrain if no convention matches. Unresolved network-specific normalization and training causes remain inconclusive.
config.oracle_caveat: LS and true-steering-subspace projection are estimator references, not universal Bayesian lower bounds or ceilings on all learned spatial priors.
config.immutable_files: All earlier study files, checkpoints and results are read-only. New outputs only in this audit directory.

published.note: Approximate raster readings, not raw author data. Fig4 P15 URformer is about -20.2 dB, not -25 dB.

task1.reachability: Inconclusive: LS and subspace-projected LS are not lower bounds for biased/Bayesian learned estimators. These tests alone cannot prove -21.6 dB impossible.
task1.theory_note: K/((P-K)*SNR) is the usual random-Gaussian-pilot ensemble reference (and a ratio-of-expected-energies approximation), not exact for this one fixed pilot bank and mean-per-channel NMSE. Exact conditional fixed-pilot expectation is also given.

task6.scope: Implementation-relevant differences in the two retrieved versions; publication prose and reference changes excluded. PDF pages 3-4 visually inspected.

differences.our_code: v3: one LayerNorm before attention, none before FFN
differences.effect: Substantive architecture difference; changes scale handling and gradient dynamics. Cause of reproduction gap remains untested.

differences.v1: No explicit distribution specified for URformer initial channel in architecture section
differences.v3: Explicit random complex Gaussian matrix, zero mean, normalized variance
differences.our_code: Paper-setting reproduction uses CN(0,1), redrawn during training; matched-supervision study instead intentionally shares spectral initialization with our model
differences.effect: v3 adds a reproducible direction, but exact meaning of normalized variance and redraw policy remain unspecified.

differences.v1: Small MLP on K (kappa); depth and output range not stated in that paragraph
differences.v3: Elementwise compact two-layer MLP mapping a scalar kappa into (0,1)
differences.effect: Two-layer form and bounded output follow v3; hidden width32 and ReLU remain implementation assumptions.

differences.v1: Gate alpha(t)=sigmoid(g(t)); FilterNet_psi and Former_phi without stage superscripts
differences.v3: FilterNet_psi(t-1), Former_phi(t-1), alpha(t-1)=sigmoid(g(t-1)); following prose still says g(t)
differences.our_code: Ten separate layers, each with its own filter, gate and Transformer
differences.effect: Index renaming does not change calculation when stages are consistent. v3 makes stage dependence clearer; weight sharing policy in authors code should be confirmed.

differences.v1: Table gives20,000 examples but not batch size or initial learning rate; inspected HTML does not specify Adam/cosine/50epochs
differences.v3: Adam, cosine annealing Tmax50, batch32, initial learning rate0.001
differences.our_code: Follows v3; Adam defaults and clipping1 remain assumptions
differences.effect: v3 supplies training settings missing in v1.

differences.v1: All proportionality constants normalized to unity; Z=|HS+B+W|
differences.v3: Explicit known atomic gain G multiplying magnitudes and used in the objective; specifies Cs transition and37.406GHz
differences.our_code: Known G is divided out; estimation uses G=1
differences.effect: Equivalent normalized measurements if G is known and noise is treated in the pre-magnitude field domain. No M-dependent SNR shift follows.

differences.v1: Eq1 defines tilde(h); adjacent prose mentions large-scale beta_k but no mapping from tilde(h) to h or beta value appears
differences.v3: Retains tilde(h) in Eq1 but drops the beta_k sentence
differences.our_code: Uses the displayed sum directly as h, unit-variance complex path gains
differences.effect: Neither version completely specifies channel gain/normalization law; no undocumented normalization is inferred.

differences.v3: P omitted from TableI but Fig3 discussion explicitly setsP20
differences.our_code: P20training and Fig3; Fig4 uses same model for pilot-transfer diagnostics
differences.effect: No Fig3 change. Separate training by pilot count remains unspecified.

differences.v3: Corrected to -20 dB at P=15; agrees with approximate plotted -20.2 dB
differences.our_code: Audit uses plotted values, not the obsolete v1 prose claim
differences.effect: Changes the reproduction target; this is a reporting correction, not an architecture change.

Path gain variance, possible normalization between tilde(h) and h
Pilot alphabet, power and refresh policy
Training SNR distribution or separate models per SNR/P

SNR_preserving_scale_check.meaning: Consistent scaling of H, B, W, H0 and noise variance preserves classical normalized error and SNR. This does not establish how the authors scale neural inputs or the effect on training.

common_M_factor_SNR_shift.scope: A shared shift applied consistently to GS,EM-GS and the learned estimator.

neural_only_normalization.reason: Classical plots cannot establish the data/noise normalization used by a separate neural training pipeline.

SNR_preserving_amplitude_scaling.reason: Scaling H, B, W and the starting estimate together preserves SNR and classical normalized error, but can affect the training of the neural blocks. This audit tests noise conventions, not this separate scaling question.

training_secondary.observed_validation_deterioration: confirmed in existing supervised training histories; consistent with overfitting
training_secondary.caution: A worse final validation score establishes deterioration after the best saved epoch; it does not prove the cause or explain the full published gap. Single-SNR training and loss comparisons were not performed in this audit.

unreachable_published_accuracy.reason: Inconclusive: LS and subspace-projected LS are not lower bounds for biased/Bayesian learned estimators. These tests alone cannot prove -21.6 dB impossible.

tasks4_5.reason: Task 3 rejects the proposed common shift; the closest scale is the already tested unshifted family. No supported normalization correction calls for repeating full neural training. Task5 diagnostics remain explicitly pending.
